claims.content: To analyze the availability and aging of inventory items by filtering on criteria such as retail category, product type, gemstone, material purity, brand, buyer, and auction status to generate a report showing item details, costs, quantities available for auction or in white realm, and summary statistics.

goal.raw_text: To analyze the availability and aging of inventory items by filtering on criteria such as retail category, product type, gemstone, material purity, brand, buyer, and auction status to generate a report showing item details, costs, quantities available for auction or in white realm, and summary statistics.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Administration system.
Inventory data exists in the system with attributes including retail category, product type, gemstone, material purity, brand, buyer, cost, and auction status.
The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu and selects filter criteria to analyze inventory availability and aging.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu and selects filter criteria to analyze inventory availability and aging.

claims.content: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page.
The system displays filter options including Retail Category, Prod_Type, Gemstone, Material_Purity, Brand, Buyer, and Groupings (Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, etc.).
The Auctioneer selects desired filter criteria from drop-down lists (e.g., selecting 'Gemstone', 'Jewelry Supplies', or specific buyers like 'Boyle', 'Ranchchild').
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Submit' button to generate the report based on selected filters.

The system displays a table of inventory items matching the criteria, showing columns for SKU, Last Seen Date, Open PO, Description, Category, Stone, Type, J/G Scores, GM/TFE, Cost, Has Image, Location, Auction Available, White Total QTY, and Red Realm counts.

The system calculates and displays a Summary Section at the bottom showing SKU Count, SKUs with no image, SKUs with no/unreliable location, Auction Available piece count, Auction Available extended cost, Auction Available Min Unit Costs, and Auction Available Max Unit Costs.
If the Auctioneer selects 'Show Items without Image' or 'Show Items with No Location', the system filters the report results to display only items matching those specific criteria.
If the Auctioneer clicks the 'Reset' button, the system clears all selected filter criteria and reverts drop-down lists to their default states.
If the Auctioneer orders columns by clicking on underlined column headers (as noted in the search results area), the system sorts the inventory table based on the selected column.
If the Auctioneer selects filter criteria that result in no matching inventory items, the system displays an empty table with zero SKU Count and zero values in the Summary Section statistics.

If the system encounters an error retrieving image data or location reliability status for specific SKUs during report generation, those items are flagged in the Summary Section under 'SKUs with no image' or 'SKUs with no/unreliable location' respectively, while still appearing in the main table if other criteria match.

The system displays a filtered list of inventory items matching the Auctioneer's selected criteria, including details such as SKU, Description, Category, Stone, Type, Cost, Location, and availability status (Auction Available, White Total QTY, Red Realm counts).
The Summary Section is updated to reflect the total count of SKUs in the current view, along with specific counts for 'SKUs with no image' and 'SKUs with no/unreliable location'.

Financial metrics for the available inventory are calculated and displayed, specifically 'Auction Available piece count', 'Auction Available extended cost', 'Auction Available Min Unit Costs', and 'Auction Available Max Unit Costs'.
